# BDSubMerge 1.0.2-beta.3

This prerelease refines timeline editing, dense table layouts, and subtitle offset controls.

## Highlights

- Double-clicking the timeline adds a user boundary and marks the current preflight as stale, but
  no longer starts a new preflight automatically. Run mapping or preflight when the boundary setup
  is ready.
- Subtitle filenames and output target paths use only the remaining visible table width. Long
  values are elided in the cell, remain available from tooltips, and no longer force the later
  mapping or output columns behind a horizontal scrollbar at normal workspace widths.
- Timeline subtitle labels now use the full visible width of each episode segment and update after
  mouse-wheel zoom instead of being cut at a fixed character count.
- The batch-offset value now sits beside the batch action in the subtitle toolbar. Every subtitle
  row also has an inline millisecond input with step buttons for direct adjustment.

## Packages

- Windows x64 ZIP with packaged GUI smoke tests and visual evidence.
- Linux x86_64 tar.gz with native X11 `xcb` startup and visual evidence under Xvfb.
- Both packages contain BDSubMerge's root `LICENSE` without a root `LICENSES` directory.

**Full Changelog**: [v1.0.2-beta.2...v1.0.2-beta.3](https://github.com/YuSaZh/BDSubMerge/compare/v1.0.2-beta.2...v1.0.2-beta.3)
